title: Uncle Emil's Creole band with Slow Drag
summary: His uncle played guitar in a small Creole band with Slow Drag; a main number was a Creole song about pepper.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you tell us about, did anyone in your family play? Your father, mother, anyone play any music?

Well, I had an uncle who used to play guitar, Emil Gayno. He used to play with a band with slow drag in it, maybe 50 or 60 years ago. They had a small band, and I mean they played a lot of Creole songs. I remember slow drag telling me one of the main numbers they used to have was a number called, Macaque Manger Piment.
Yeah, that'd be the monkey pepper chord or something like that. You can imagine the chords went with that.
